question: Bails are used in which of the following games / sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bails** are small pieces of wood placed on top of the stumps in the game of **Cricket**.
 
• The bails are used to determine if the wicket is broken when the ball hits the stumps or when the batsman is run out or stumped.
